result_text: I escaped the repository name in both tooltips in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`. Nothing is committed. - **Language blocks** (`addLangInfoBlock`, around line 1197): the repo name is run through `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4` before the `(N LOC)` suffix is added. - **Size distribution table** (around line 1454): same escaping for the name, the lines of code are unchanged. - **Import:** added `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils`, which the reports module already uses elsewhere. The browser decodes the escaped entities back inside the `title` attribute, so `acme "shop"` shows as written, with no markup in the page. Counts, LOC values, ordering and layout are untouched. The reports module compiles offline. `mvn -o -pl reports test -Dtest='*Landscape*'` ran without errors, but no test matched the pattern, so nothing exercises this path. I did not render a report with a quoted repo name to check the tooltip in a browser.
